top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a single, falsifiable invention (magic-wavelength trapping of many atoms) whose central claim, clocks at about 1e-18, is established and independently reproduced and surpassed in several laboratories; the Katori and Ye allocation maps onto concept/first lattice spectroscopy and record-accuracy realization, the omitted claimants lie outside the pair, and a citation tied to the lattice clock keeps it distinct from the 2005 and 2012 prizes. P002 is a strong new-phenomenon case but is younger, the pairing mechanism is unresolved, and the trio leaves out Cao and the earlier band theorists. Either award is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for P001 or P002; no documented tie to Katori, Ye, MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero or Bistritzer. Field proximity (WACQT, superconducting circuits) concerns only B046/B024, which are not in the slate.
